subject: Renewal + Territory Rebalance: EU primary, APAC shadow & SLO adjustments

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + Territory Rebalance: EU primary, APAC shadow & SLO adjustments

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the productive call on Friday. As you prepare for renewal, I wanted to capture our proposed approach so Procurement and TechOps have a single reference:

Summary (proposal):
- Term: 24 months (instead of 12) to give Solara price stability and predictable capacity planning.
- Residency: EU node becomes primary for all live traffic for Solara EU customers; APAC will be configured as a warm/shadow region (no live writes, failover-only) for the first 6 months, then move to warm-active as traffic justifies.
- Capacity: baseline tokens increased from 3B/month to 5B/month (to cover anticipated Q1 seasonal peak).
- SLOs: 95th pct latency SLO tightened to 300ms for production EU tier; APAC failover SLO 500ms. Detailed SLA table attached.
- Pricing: incremental upsell for residency + dedicated standby capacity; proposed pricing and uplift attached.

Attached: redwood_residency_matrix_v3.xlsx, proposed_sla_table.pdf — these show the config, routes, and failover timeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement to confirm required PO format and any legal redlines (cc'd TechOps & Procurement).
2) Sign SOW amendment for EU residency and APAC warm standby (I can push a DocuSign link once legal thumbs-up).
3) Technical kick — Grace to run a 2-week readiness sprint for cutover, and Ben to coordinate capacity provisioning.

Happy to adjust — what would Procurement need to move to terms?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0123

Dylan —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few initial asks from our side:
1) Procurement: we need a line itemized quote that separates (a) residency fee, (b) dedicated standby capacity, (c) per-token rate. Can you provide a CSV-friendly pricing summary?
2) Security/Compliance: TechOps wants a list of EU data handling controls and confirmation that logs/audit data will remain in EU while APAC is in shadow mode.
3) Cutover window: prefer weekends, and we need a rollback window spelled out.

If you can get the updated SOW + pricing, Procurement will start review.

—Kate
VP Product Operations | Solara Health

Team —

Tech/Compliance note for Solara TechOps: please feel free to forward this to Kate/ops. Short summary:
- Data residency: Customer PII and access logs will be stored in the EU primary region (AWS eu-west-1) while APAC remains warm/shadow. APAC instances will only hold ephemeral model KV caches and transient telemetry required for failover.
- Access & audits: Any audit exports or flight-records are retained in EU and accessible via the RedAudit export tool. We will provide a scoped SOC2 artifact package in parallel with the SOW.
- Rollback plan: 4-hour rollback window during cutover with automated traffic re-route back to original EU endpoints; runbook and run-of-show will be provided during the technical kickoff.

I'll attach the minimal SOC2 artifact checklist and the short-runbook with the 4-hour rollback steps to the SOW packet.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
